item.title: Katz to Beirut: Act against Hezbollah or ‘Lebanon will pay the full price’
item.description: “We have no territorial claims against Lebanon, but we will not be prepared for Lebanese territory to become a base for firing at the State of Israel.” The post Katz to Beirut: Act against Hezbollah or ‘Lebanon will pay the full price’ appeared first on JNS.org.
